leaves.doc: Fowler (2026), section 2·1, p. 613: a singular modulus of primitive equation discriminant Δ has degree h(Δ) over ℚ, with h(Δ) the proper ideal class number.
leaves.flag: Supplied reading of the publisher PDF: fork issue #14, comment 6973419601. Conditional preview: the short Weierstrass coordinate comparison has no provider yet.
leaves.source: Fowler, Some uniform effective results on André–Oort for sums of powers in ℂⁿ, Math. Proc. Cambridge Philos. Soc. 180 (2026) 607–641, section 2·1, pp. 612–613; manuscript L584–587.
